services.package_outcome_draft: Prepare and submit the LLP incorporation application and prepare the LLP agreement using client-approved partner, contribution and governance instructions.
scope_evidence_items: 2 Designated Partner DPINs (historical pricing evidence)
FiLLiP form filing with MCA (historical pricing evidence)
LLP Agreement drafting (historical pricing evidence)
PAN and TAN issuance (historical pricing evidence)
known_exclusions_evidence_only: Government statutory portal filing fees payable at actuals (historical pricing record).
Class-3 DSC tokens procured separately at actuals or client-provided (historical pricing record).
eligibility_prerequisites_evidence: Minimum two designated partners who are natural persons, with at least one designated partner resident in India (Section 7 LLP Act, 2008)
Valid DPIN/DIN and Class 3 Digital Signature Certificate (DSC) for designated partners
Proposed LLP name complying with name reservation guidelines under Rule 18 of LLP Rules, 2009
Registered office premises located in India (Section 13)
client_documents_evidence: PAN cards and identity proofs (Passport / Voter ID / DL) of all partners
Residential address proofs (< 2 months old: bank statement / utility bill) of all partners
Registered office utility bill (< 2 months old) and signed owner No Objection Certificate (NOC)
Executed LLP Agreement stamped per state stamp act and filed in Form 3 within 30 days of incorporation
eligibility_exceptions_evidence: Bodies corporate acting as partner must appoint an individual natural person as their designated partner nominee
Non-profit or charitable objects are prohibited; LLPs must be formed with a view to profit
owner_decisions_and_risks: Pricing evidence lists 2 DPINs, FiLLiP, LLP Agreement, PAN and TAN; service-page copy also refers to RUN-LLP and Form 3 filing. These must be reconciled before a package scope is approved.
The eligibility record says Form 3 is to be filed within 30 days, but pricing inclusions do not clearly state whether Form 3 filing is included. Owner must decide and confirm delivery capacity.

services.package_outcome_draft: Review the applicant's enterprise details and activity classification, prepare the Udyam application and deliver the generated certificate if the portal accepts the application.
scope_evidence_items: Aadhaar and PAN verification (historical pricing evidence)
NIC code classification and mapping (historical pricing evidence)
Official Udyam certificate delivery (historical pricing evidence)
eligibility_prerequisites_evidence: Enterprise falls within Micro, Small, or Medium classification thresholds based on composite investment and turnover criteria under MSMED Act, 2006
Valid Aadhaar number of proprietor (for proprietorship), managing partner (for partnership), or authorized signatory (for company/LLP)
PAN of the enterprise linked with Aadhaar, and GSTIN (where GST registration is legally mandatory)
client_documents_evidence: Aadhaar number and PAN of the applicant / enterprise
Bank account number and IFSC code of the business entity
National Industry Classification (NIC) 2-digit, 4-digit, and 5-digit business activity codes
Investment and turnover figures matching Income Tax and GST returns
eligibility_exceptions_evidence: Enterprises engaged exclusively in speculative, gambling, or negative-list activities are ineligible
A single enterprise cannot obtain more than one Udyam registration; multiple units must be added under one Udyam number
owner_decisions_and_risks: The page/package wording uses 'Instant' and historical 'All Inclusive' pricing language; no turnaround guarantee or tax-inclusive fee should be assumed.
Eligibility and NIC activity classification must be checked against current official portal requirements; source record remains SOURCE_IDENTIFIED, not legally verified.

services.package_outcome_draft: Coordinate the incorporation dossier and submit the applicable MCA incorporation forms using client-approved company, subscriber, director and registered-office information.
scope_evidence_items: 2 DINs via SPICe+ (historical pricing record; page states up to 3 directors — discrepancy)
Name approval via SPICe+ Part A (historical pricing evidence)
MoA and AoA drafting (historical pricing evidence)
PAN and TAN issuance (historical pricing evidence)
Bank current account opening support (historical pricing evidence; outcome not guaranteed)
known_exclusions_evidence_only: Government statutory portal filing fees payable at actuals (historical pricing record).
Class-3 DSC tokens procured separately at actuals or client-provided (historical pricing record).
eligibility_prerequisites_evidence: Minimum 2 subscribers/directors (maximum 200 members under Section 2(68) Companies Act, 2013)
At least one director must be resident in India (stayed in India for ≥ 182 days during the financial year per Section 149(3))
Director Identification Number (DIN) or allotment via SPICe+ Part B, and Class 3 Digital Signature Certificate (DSC)
Approved company name reservation via SPICe+ Part A (valid for 20 days per Rule 9A)
Registered office premises located in India
client_documents_evidence: PAN cards and government identity proofs (Passport / Voter ID / DL) of all subscribers and directors
Residential address proofs (< 2 months old: bank statement / utility bill) of all subscribers and directors
Registered office utility bill (< 2 months old) and signed owner No Objection Certificate (NOC)
Electronic Memorandum of Association (e-MoA INC-33) and Articles of Association (e-AoA INC-34)
Declarations in Form INC-9 by subscribers/directors and Form DIR-2 consent
eligibility_exceptions_evidence: Foreign nationals acting as subscribers/directors must have identity and address documents apostilled or notarized in home jurisdiction
Cannot invite the public to subscribe for any securities of the company
owner_decisions_and_risks: Pricing record includes 2 DINs, while service-page scope refers to DIN allocation for up to 3 directors. Confirm exact cap and price basis before approval.
Service page includes professional certification/pre-scrutiny and AGILE-PRO-S components; confirm named qualified professionals, scope and delivery responsibility.
Bank account opening support must not be represented as guaranteed bank account approval.

services.service_name: DPIIT Startup India Recognition & Section 140 Tax Holiday Assessment
services.package_outcome_draft: Assess the applicant's startup profile against the current recognition framework, organise the evidence dossier and assist with the relevant portal application; any tax-incentive or IMB work must be separately scoped.
scope_evidence_items: Innovation and scalability letter drafting (historical pricing evidence)
DPIIT portal application and follow-up (historical pricing evidence)
IMB tax exemption guidance (historical pricing evidence; separate scope boundary to be decided)
known_exclusions_evidence_only: Government statutory portal filing fees described as payable at actuals in historical pricing record; confirm whether any portal charge currently applies.
eligibility_prerequisites_evidence: Entity incorporated as Private Limited Company, LLP, or registered Partnership Firm within the preceding 10 years
Turnover has not exceeded INR 100 crore in any preceding financial year since incorporation
Entity is working towards innovation, development, or improvement of products, processes, or services, or scalable business model with high employment/wealth potential
Entity was not formed by splitting up or reconstruction of a business already in existence
client_documents_evidence: Certificate of Incorporation / Registration Certificate
Pitch deck and write-up on innovation/scalability with website or mobile application links
CA certified net worth certificate (mandatory for Section 56(2)(viib) angel tax exemption Form 2)
eligibility_exceptions_evidence: Sole proprietorships, public limited companies, and trusts are ineligible for DPIIT recognition
Entities formed by splitting up or reconstruction of an existing business are ineligible
owner_decisions_and_risks: The eligibility dataset still reflects older turnover and Section 56(2)(viib) language and is not legally verified, while the current service page refers to 2026 G.S.R. 108(E) and Income-tax Act 2025 Section 140. A full legal/regulatory reconciliation is mandatory before offering this package.
DPIIT recognition does not itself establish entitlement to a separate tax benefit. Do not promise a tax holiday, grant, subsidy, IPR rebate or recognition outcome.
Pricing evidence bundles recognition drafting, portal follow-up and IMB guidance; separate recognition-only and tax/IMB advisory scopes and fees.

services.service_name: Brand Name, Logo & Slogan Trademark Registration (Form TM-A)
services.draft_package_name: Trademark Filing — One Mark / Defined Class Scope
services.package_outcome_draft: Conduct a documented preliminary search and classification exercise, prepare the application and submit the agreed mark/application particulars to the Trade Marks Registry.
scope_evidence_items: Phonetic and wordmark similarity search (historical pricing evidence)
Nice Classification mapping (historical pricing evidence)
Form TM-A drafting and Form 48 authorisation (historical pricing evidence)
Digital e-filing and official receipt/application number (service-page evidence)
Application status tracking through examination report generation (service-page evidence)
known_exclusions_evidence_only: Government statutory filing fees payable at actuals (historical pricing record).
eligibility_prerequisites_evidence: Distinctive brand name, logo, slogan, or mark used or proposed to be used in commerce in relation to goods or services
Mark is not devoid of distinctive character (Section 9 Trade Marks Act, 1999) and not deceptively similar to prior registered marks (Section 11)
client_documents_evidence: Form TM-48 Power of Attorney authorizing Trademark Agent / Advocate
Logo / wordmark graphic representation in high-resolution format
User affidavit with documentary proof where prior use is claimed
Udyam registration or startup certificate for 50% government fee concession
eligibility_exceptions_evidence: Generic, descriptive, scandalous, or prohibited marks under the Emblems and Names Act cannot be registered
owner_decisions_and_risks: Clarify whether package unit means one mark, one applicant, one class, or another defined filing unit; historical pricing is 'starting from'.
No guarantee of acceptance, registration, exclusivity, or successful opposition/examination outcome. Filing acknowledgement is not registration.
Confirm who is legally authorised and professionally responsible for search opinion, Form 48 execution, filing and any response to examination/opposition.
